verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python framework whose agents run in your own process. The docs say an agent can run behind a web frontend, in a terminal, on a background queue, or "as a plain object you call run() on." It is model-agnostic and works with OpenAI-compatible providers, and the vendor's Logfire observability is explicitly "built-in (but optional)." A community user pairing it with Langfuse instead shows the vendor platform isn't required. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of open-source licensing and self-hosting, explicit evidence of support for locally hosted or self-served models, and independent hands-on reports of fully vendor-free on-prem deployment.
